verses.ar: وَتَقُولُ فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ: «أَحْمَدُكَ يَارَبُّ، لِأَنَّهُ إِذْ غَضِبْتَ عَلَيَّ ٱرْتَدَّ غَضَبُكَ فَتُعَزِّينِي.
verses.kjv: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
verses.web: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.

verses.ar: هُوَذَا ٱللهُ خَلَاصِي فَأَطْمَئِنُّ وَلَا أَرْتَعِبُ، لِأَنَّ يَاهَ يَهْوَهَ قُوَّتِي وَتَرْنِيمَتِي وَقَدْ صَارَ لِي خَلَاصًا».
verses.kjv: Behold, God [is] my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH [is] my strength and [my] song; he also is become my salvation.
verses.web: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”

verses.ar: فَتَسْتَقُونَ مِيَاهًا بِفَرَحٍ مِنْ يَنَابِيعِ ٱلْخَلَاصِ.
verses.kjv: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.web: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

verses.ar: وَتَقُولُونَ فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ: «ٱحْمَدُوا ٱلرَّبَّ. ٱدْعُوا بِٱسْمِهِ. عَرِّفُوا بَيْنَ ٱلشُّعُوبِ بِأَفْعَالِهِ. ذَكِّرُوا بِأَنَّ ٱسْمَهُ قَدْ تَعَالَى.
verses.kjv: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
verses.web: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!

verses.ar: رَنِّمُوا لِلرَّبِّ لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ صَنَعَ مُفْتَخَرًا. لِيَكُنْ هَذَا مَعْرُوفًا فِي كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this [is] known in all the earth.
verses.web: Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!

verses.ar: صَوِّتِي وَٱهْتِفِي يَا سَاكِنَةَ صِهْيَوْنَ، لِأَنَّ قُدُّوسَ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَظِيمٌ فِي وَسَطِكِ».
verses.kjv: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great [is] the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
verses.web: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
